$comment: Community catalog of daedalus-packaged apps. One template per popular runtime (ROADMAP: adoption). Apps marked buildable:true have source in this repo and can be rebuilt with hub/build.sh. Recipe rows document the canonical source layout to replicate outside the repo.

apps.name: hello-web
apps.description: Zero-dependency Python HTTP server. The fastest 'it's just the file' demo.

apps.name: bottle-web
apps.description: Python Bottle app with a vendored site-packages directory — shows dependency embedding with zero pip/network.

apps.name: clinic-agent
apps.description: Offline AI for rural clinics / agricultural cooperatives. Gemma via local Ollama with a pure-stdlib offline fallback. Flagship demo.

apps.name: Express API
apps.description: Canonical Express app: package.json + index.js + node_modules. Build with SISR delta updates for free.

apps.name: FastAPI service
apps.description: Canonical FastAPI app: app/main.py + requirements.txt. --teleport-style dependency embed via pipdle-free vendoring or --embed-interpreter.

apps.name: Spring Boot API
apps.description: Spring Boot service. daedalus embeds a minimal jlink JRE (--embed-interpreter java) so the artifact runs without a system JDK.

apps.name: Rails API
apps.description: Ruby on Rails service. Bundler is auto-detected from the Gemfile.

apps.name: Laravel API
apps.description: PHP Laravel service — detected by composer.json.

apps.name: Go server (Gin)
apps.description: Go binary: daedalus runs `go build` via Cargo-style detection and stages the resulting static binary.

apps.name: Zig binary
apps.description: Zig binary: daedalus runs `zig build` via detection of build.zig/build.zig.zon and stages the resulting native binary.

apps.name: Dart CLI
apps.description: Dart AOT-compiled CLI: daedalus runs `dart compile exe` on the entrypoint and packages the resulting native binary.

apps.name: Flutter app
apps.description: Flutter desktop bundle: daedalus runs `flutter build <platform>` and bundles the release into a self-extracting .de.
